LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingSpread: Spread a strategic blast over several moments
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingSpreadDesc: On, a strategic warhead destroys the struck map a slice at a time, from the centre outward, and the game keeps responding. Off, the missile mod's own way: everything in one go.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnSpreadOff: Off: the whole blast happens in one frame, which can freeze the game for minutes on a large map until Windows closes it.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingBudget: Time each moment may spend on the blast: {MS} ms
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingBudgetDesc: Higher finishes the blast sooner but makes the game stutter while it runs; lower keeps it smooth and takes longer. A moment is one drawn frame, about 16 ms at 60 frames a second.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnBudget: Above 25 ms the game visibly stutters while a blast runs.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingWhiteScreen: Take up to {MS} ms a moment while the screen is still white
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingWhiteScreenD: For the first seconds after impact the screen is white or fading back, so a slower moment costs nothing you can see, and the blast is mostly done before you see the map again.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingShelter: What shelters people and things from a blast
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingShelterDesc: Overhead mountain shields what is under it. Built roofs never do: the blast tears them off first.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnShelter: The blast now sweeps mountain interiors too, which takes several times longer on a mountainous map.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingRubble: Leave rubble and salvage where buildings stood
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingRubbleDesc: Off, buildings in the blast are gone without trace. On, each leaves its rubble, slag and a share of its materials, as when a building is destroyed in a fight.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnRubble: Many times slower: every building's rubble and materials are placed one by one.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingCorpsesDesc: Whether the bodies of those the blast kills are left where they fell.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingHoldRooms: Rebuild rooms once per moment during a blast
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingHoldRoomsDes: On, the game works out its rooms and regions once per moment instead of after every wall that falls. Switch it off only if a blast leaves rooms behaving oddly, and report it.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingMessages: Tell me when a blast takes a while, and when it ends
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingMessagesDesc: A message when a blast is still running after two seconds, and one when it has spent itself.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingFragments: Wall fragments from a strategic blast
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingFragmentsDes: Walls shattered by heavy damage throw fragments. A strategic blast pauses the game, so the fragments of every wall hang in the air at once.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_FragmentsAsCombatEx: As many as in a fight
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnFragmentsReduce: Buildings are torn down the slow way so their fragments can fly: about ten fragments each, and the blast takes several times longer.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnFragmentsFull: About a hundred fragments per building, piling up while the game is paused until each one slows the next: a blast on a town can take tens of minutes.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_FragmentsOffInComba: Wall fragments are switched off in Combat Extended's own settings, so this changes nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SectionAfterEffects: The blast, the heat and what follows
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingBlastModel: Fireball, blast and heat by distance from ground zero
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingBlastModelDe: For the extinction-class warhead: everything near the centre of the struck map is vaporised and the ground scoured; further out buildings fall and people burn; at the edges walls stand, plants wilt and fires start. Off, the warhead destroys everything on the map evenly.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnBlastModelOff: Off: no burns, wilting, ash or pulse, and the warhead's fires light a fifth of every cell on the map in a single moment.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingFullStrike: Full strike on every settlement in range
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingFullStrikeDe: Off, only the settlement the missile was aimed at takes the fireball and blast; other open maps within the warhead's reach get the heat, fires and fallout. On, each of them is struck as if it were ground zero.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnFullStrike: Each map in range takes a full strike of its own, one after another: several times longer when you have more than one map open nearby.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingFiresDesc: How many fires the heat starts in what is still standing, most near the blast and fewer towards the edges.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_WarnFires: Hundreds to thousands of fires burn at once when the game runs again, and each costs a little every moment until it dies.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingFalloutDesc: What settles on the land after the strike.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_FalloutAutomatic: Radioactive fallout where it can, otherwise nuclear winter
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_RimatomicsAbsent: Radioactive fallout, radiation sickness and flash blindness come from Dubs Rimatomics, which is not active, so the strike brings nuclear winter.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingClouds: Fallout clouds drifting from the strike: {COUNT}
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingCloudsDesc: Clouds that drift across the world for days or weeks and bring fallout to any settlement they pass over.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingRadiation: Radiation sickness and flash blindness for survivors
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingRadiationDes: Those who live through the strike in the open take a dose of radiation, worse nearer the centre, and may be blinded by the flash.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingPollutionDes: The scoured ground at the centre is polluted, and patches of the ground around it.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_SettingEmpDesc: Powered buildings and mechanoids still standing in the open stop for a few hours.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_BlastStillRunning: The blast is still tearing through {PLACE}.
LanguageData.PhobosMissilePatches_BlastSpent: The blast over {PLACE} has spent itself.
